item.title: Hand Tendon Displacement Evaluation Technology
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: Vector Doppler Imaging can estimate motion components in different directions. Besides blood-flow analysis, this project applies the method to hand tendon movement evaluation, providing more quantitative displacement information for rehabilitation assessment research.
